items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: And he played — Chuck Mangione played with Blakey.

ctx.x: And this was before he became — I wonder if he’s — does he have a legacy at Eastman of a sort?

To a degree. Yeah. I think so. We’re respectful of him. I don’t really know him. But he had a hand in getting things going I think. I do. And his brother Gap. No you can’t take that away. And he played — Chuck Mangione played with Blakey.
And Cannonball discovered them — the jazz brothers. Cannonball brought them into Riverside Records.
